about_lead: Gitscout turns a public GitHub profile into a football player card. Everything below is computed only from public data; there's no AI and no manual scoring.
about_stats_intro: Each stat is scored from 0 to 100 on a logarithmic scale: the first steps come quickly, the top gets harder. Full marks are set by the most extreme profiles in the world, so a 99 is rare.
about_stat_act: Contributions in the last 12 months: commits, pull requests, reviews and issues. Full marks at {full}.
about_stat_imp: Stars and forks on your own repos, plus organization repos in proportion to your share of the commits. Full marks at {stars} stars.
about_stat_rep: Pull requests merged into other people's repos, and code reviews in the last 12 months. Full marks at {prs} PRs.
about_stat_con: Active weeks in the last 52 weeks, the longest daily streak and how many of the last {years} years were active.
about_stat_exp: Total contributions over the years and account age. Full marks at {years} years.
about_ovr_body: The overall rating (OVR) is the weighted average of the six stats, spread onto a FIFA-like curve: active developers land around 70–85, and 90+ is for the very best.
about_position_body: We look at the language mix of every repo you own or actively contribute to. Each repo counts by its own mix, and popular repos weigh more, so one big generated file can't decide your position.
about_position_groups: Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, Vue, Svelte… · Backend: Go, Java, PHP, Ruby, C#… · Mobile: Swift, Kotlin, Dart · Systems: C, C++, Rust, Zig · Data: Python with notebooks or AI work, R, Julia · DevOps: Shell, HCL, Dockerfile · Game Dev: Unity and Godot
about_position_fullstack: If both Frontend and Backend reach {share}, the position is Full Stack.
about_badges_body: Badges reward achievements, such as a long streak, many reviews or a well-documented profile. They don't change the rating. The title comes from your strongest stat and card type.
about_data_body: Only public GitHub data is used; private repos are left out. A card is saved when it's first scouted and can be refreshed from its page.
duel_image_downloaded: Clipboard isn't available here, so the image was downloaded
about_disclaimer: These scores measure GitHub activity, not how good a developer is. A great engineer can be quiet on GitHub, and a very active profile can outscore them.
